entities.name: Eugène Protot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Charles Eugène Protot was a French lawyer (avocat) and a political opponent of the Second Empire. During the Paris Commune in 1871, he was minister of justice for a month before going into exile until 1880. After his return to France he was prevented from working at the Bar and earned a living as a specialist in Oriental languages.
